sloka: ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।गन्धमाल्यांस्तथा भक्ष्यानादाय सहसा ययुः ।। ६.६०.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: te rāvaṇasamādiṣṭā māṁsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ ।gandhamālyāṁstathā bhakṣyānādāya sahasā yayuḥ ।। 6.60.23 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.
translations.hindi: कपिवर वीर्यवान्‌ तार ने एक बड़े पेड़ के प्रहार से कुम्भ हनु के सिर को चकनाचूर कर दिआ। इस प्रहार से कुम्भहनु ने भी युद्ध करते हुए प्राण त्याग दिए
